greeting.text: Hello. Well met. Hi there. What can I do for you? Can I help you?

click.text: Welcome in, love. Mind the step, and the cheese.
Everything on the shelf is for sale. Some of it even wants to be.
Have a look through the stock. I keep it honest, mostly.
Anything catch your eye? Besides the smell of the Brie?

advance.text: There, that's the days gone. The shelves look older already.
Time flies when you're watching stock spoil.
All done. The Brie's delighted. Nobody else is.
Another stretch behind us, and not one item sold. Lovely.

worthless.text: That concert's been and gone, love. Those passes are kindling now.
Well, those tickets won't be getting anyone through any door.
The music's over, and so is the value of those passes.
